name: Mickel Williams-Brown
lede: Digital marketing lead working across paid media, CRM and measurement. Every certification I earn ends up here, with its verification link.
contactLine: Best way to reach me is email. I answer everything.
about: I work in digital marketing, mostly on the unglamorous half: campaign structure, tracking, and the reporting that tells you whether any of it worked.
The certifications here are how I keep current with the platforms I actually use. They're a mix of formal exams, platform academies, and courses I finished because a specific problem needed solving.
